text: Tyndale Biscoe School is located in the Sheikh Bagh neighbourhood of Lal Chowk, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. Founded in 1880 CE, it is one of the oldest schools in the region, with S.P. School, established in 1874 CE, being the oldest. The school was initiated by Christian missionaries and named after Canon Cecil Tyndale-Biscoe (1863–1949). It maintains current affiliations with the Church Mission Society, and its first principal was Reverend J. H. Knowles. The institution has five departments. It is well known for its extra-curricular activities, particularly swimming, skiing, mountain climbing, camping, and regatta. The school emphasizes physical activities such as mountaineering, trekking, boating, football, cricket, and swimming to foster courage, masculinity, and physical fitness. When football was introduced, students initially resisted due to the belief that cow leather, used in the balls, was holy, and touching it was blasphemous; instead, they played using wooden clogs (known as Khraav in Kashmiri) in their feet. Similarly, when boating was introduced, students disliked it because boatmen were not considered respectable in Kashmiri society; however, over time, the activity was adopted, and the school boys became proficient paddlers and rowers. In 1880, Reverend J. H. Knowles laid the foundation of the C.M.S. School on the premises of the Modern Chest Disease Hospital (Drugjan) in Srinagar, starting with five pupils. By 1883, the number of boys increased to 30. In 1890, the Government allowed the C.M.S. to relocate the school to downtown, moving it to a large house and compound on the riverbank at Fateh Kadal, where the student population grew to about 200. In 1891, Canon C.E. Tyndale-Biscoe joined the school, when the roll stood at 250 pupils. The primary school evolved into a middle school and later into a high school, which was later named the Hadow Memorial School in honour of its honorary treasurer for 40 years. Eventually, five additional mission schools were established—one in each part of the capital city and one in Anantnag.
